unifiedNote: Pairing schemes are UNIFIED across all 9 Punjab BISE boards. PECTAA notifications No. PECTAA/C&C Unit/2026/1238 (Grade 9) and No. PECTAA/C&C Unit/2026/1239 (Grade 11), both dated 06.11.2026, apply to all nine boards (Lahore, Gujranwala, Rawalpindi, Sargodha, Faisalabad, Sahiwal, Multan, Dera Ghazi Khan, Bahawalpur) for the 2026-27 session and BISE Annual Examination 2027. Pre-2027 schemes were likewise uniform across Punjab boards (PBCC-coordinated). Each scheme below is therefore recorded ONCE per class/subject and applies to all 9 boards. Class 10 and Class 12 smart-syllabus/pairing-scheme notifications had NOT been issued by PECTAA as of 7 Nov 2026, so 10th/12th entries use the latest available 2026 schemes.
